title: Safe{Mobile}
summary: Securely sign transactions and manage your Safe accounts on the go
description:
Secure Smart Account Signing, Now Seamlessly Mobile

Safe{Wallet} is the most secure way to manage your smart accounts and sign transactions from your phone. Whether you’re managing an organizational treasury or your personal DeFi positions, the Safe{Wallet} mobile app gives you the power of multisig security, real-time notifications, and transaction transparency—all in your pocket.

Key Features:
• Secure Signing on the Go – Approve transactions from anywhere with full transaction decoding and simulation.
• Multisig Support – Sign transactions with multiple signers directly from your mobile device.
• Real-Time Notifications – Instantly get notified about pending and completed transactions.
• Built-in Security – Transactions are scanned with Blockaid, can be simulated with Tenderly and the app is audited by Certora.
• Cross-Chain Support – Manage Safe accounts on Ethereum, Gnosis, Arbitrum, Base and other major Layer 2s.
• Designed for Signers – Co-sign and review queued transactions with a smooth, signer-first experience.
• Simple Onboarding – Easily import your Safe accounts and start signing in seconds.

Built from the ground up in React Native, the Safe{Wallet} app ensures fast performance and a consistent experience across iOS and Android. Whether you're a crypto power user or part of a multisig setup, Safe{Wallet} mobile keeps your assets protected and your actions secure
recentChanges:
WalletConnect dApps support:
- Connect your Safe account to dApps via WalletConnect
- Scan QR codes with the new button in the home screen header, or connect via deep link from the dApp
- Review and confirm dApp transactions directly in the app
- Manage connections under Account > Connected dApps

Other improvements:
- Edit the nonce of draft transactions
- Edit token approval amounts in draft swap transactions
- Bug fixes and stability improvements
